name: Soyuz MS-11
about: Soyuz MS-11 (2018-098A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2018 Dec  3. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2018 Dec  3), held fixed
docked to S36086; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q28666067), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory
